WITH lock_check AS (
  SELECT pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(104104) AS acquired
)
SELECT 
  lock_check.acquired,
  d.id,
  d.tenant_id,
  d.domain,
  d.proposed_payload,
  d.outcome_type,
  d.final_payload,
  d.feedback_note,
  d.delta_analysis,
  d.created_at
FROM lock_check
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT id, tenant_id, domain, proposed_payload, outcome_type, final_payload, feedback_note, delta_analysis, created_at
  FROM decision_outcomes
  WHERE tenant_id = COALESCE($1, 'default')
    AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
  ORDER BY created_at ASC
  LIMIT 25
) d ON lock_check.acquired = true;

SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN $1::boolean IS NOT TRUE THEN NULL
    ELSE create_learning_candidate(
      $2, 'rafael', $3, $4, $5, $6, $7::numeric, $8, $9::integer, $10, $11, NULL
    )
  END AS candidate_id,
  CASE 
    WHEN $1::boolean IS NOT TRUE THEN NULL
    ELSE insert_structured_memory(
      $2, 'rafael', 'PREFERENCE', $4, $5, 
      jsonb_build_object('rule', $6, 'preference_type', $12, 'preference_value', $13, 'category', $3),
      'INFERRED_INTERACTION', $7::numeric, NULL
    )
  END AS memory_id,
  $14 AS text,
  $15::bigint AS chat_id,
  $16::boolean AS has_auto,
  $2 AS tenant_id,
  $12 AS preference_type,
  $13 AS preference_value,
  $7::numeric AS promotion_score;

SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN $1::boolean IS TRUE AND $2::uuid IS NOT NULL AND $4 IS NOT NULL THEN (
      SELECT promote_safe_preference_auto(
        $2::uuid,
        $3,
        $4,
        $5,
        'v2.3.2-db-authoritative',
        $6::numeric
      )
    )
    ELSE FALSE
  END AS auto_promoted,
  $7 AS text,
  $8::bigint AS chat_id,
  $3 AS tenant_id;
